subject.title: Fix subagent announce restart recovery cascade

question: Should this PR's persisted announce recovery marker and stricter tool-free announce handoff behavior be accepted after `check-lint` is rerun or cleared?
rationale: The patch is technically coherent, but it changes durable session recovery semantics and the Codex/CLI tool boundary, which automation should not silently accept for maintainers.

options.title: Clean lint and land
options.body: Rerun or clear `check-lint`, then merge with the intentional `announceLastRun` marker and tool-free announce invariant.

options.title: Choose a different terminal state
options.body: Ask for a small revision if `killed` is not the maintainer-approved persisted state for aborted delivery-only announce runs.

options.title: Pause for broader delivery design
options.body: Hold the PR if maintainers want a general inter-session delivery recovery model instead of an announce-specific marker.

recommendation.title: Clean lint and land
recommendation.body: Rerun or clear `check-lint`, then merge with the intentional `announceLastRun` marker and tool-free announce invariant.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest direct history across the original restart recovery, prompt-suppression, and Codex native tool-surface code involved in the merge-risk choice.
